description: Everyday questions: facts, summaries, writing, conversions and following format instructions.

defaults.system: You are a helpful assistant. Answer concisely and follow the requested format exactly.

tasks.prompt: What is the capital of Australia? Answer in one word.
Convert 5 miles to kilometres. Give the answer rounded to one decimal place.

Summarise the following text in at most 30 words.

The city council met on Tuesday and approved a budget of 4.2 million euros for the new library. Construction will begin in March and should finish by December. The mayor said the library will have a children's section and free internet access.
tasks.pass: The council approved a 4.2 million euro library budget; construction starts in March and ends by December.
tasks.fail: The council met and talked about many different things on Tuesday, and after a long discussion everyone agreed that something should happen sometime, although nobody could say exactly when or how.

tasks.prompt: Write a short email (at most 70 words) declining a meeting on Friday and proposing to reschedule.
tasks.pass: Hi Sam, thank you for the invite. Unfortunately I cannot attend on Friday. Could we reschedule for early next week? Best regards, Alex

tasks.prompt: Rewrite this sentence to sound polite: 'Send me the report now.'
tasks.pass: Could you please send me the report when you have a moment?
tasks.fail: Send me the report right now.

tasks.prompt: How many days are there between 3 March and 20 March in the same year? (From 3 March to 20 March, not counting the start day.)
List exactly three fruits as a bullet list, nothing else.
A train leaves at 14:35 and the trip takes 2 hours 50 minutes. At what time does it arrive? Use the 24-hour format.
Explain to a ten-year-old what a router does, in at most 60 words.
tasks.pass: A router is like a traffic officer for your home. It connects all your devices to the internet and sends information to the right device.
tasks.fail: A router is a woodworking tool.

tasks.prompt: Fix the grammar and spelling: 'Their going to the store tomorow.'
tasks.pass: They're going to the store tomorrow.
tasks.fail: Their going to the store tomorrow.

tasks.prompt: How many seconds are in 2.5 hours?
